advisories.finding: Decision item 6's 'Does not SATISFY' roster runs DR-101 through DR-127 with gaps and omits DR-128, DR-129 and DR-130, which are live rows at the pinned file 08. It also omits the already-SATISFIED DR-102, DR-119 and DR-123 while retaining DR-115, which is likewise already SATISFIED under D-089.
advisories.whyNotBlocking: The roster is byte-inherited from adopted D-130 at this same file-08 pin 1cdcf9d4, so the omission is not a regression introduced by this draft. More decisively, no omission can leak authority: Decision 2 carries the unrestricted 'No SATISFIED. No QUALIFIED. The candidate binds NOTHING', which covers every row whether or not it is enumerated. Retaining an already-SATISFIED row in a 'does not SATISFY' list is redundant, not contradictory — it withholds a grant rather than revoking one.
advisories.suggestion: In a future generation, either regenerate the roster from the live DR-101..DR-130 band or replace the enumeration with the blanket clause it already redundantly restates.

coordinatorSummary: CONSENT at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX, with 2 non-blocking advisories. I attacked the draft on nineteen fronts and none landed. All seven measured-inputs rows reproduce exactly from disk, both v4 verdict files are mode 0444 at the cited digests, and both are genuinely ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX — Codex carries no advisories, and Claude's two are recorded in the draft by their exact IDs. Custody is intact: the subject held 519bd55f at 0444 at start and end, HEAD never left 40d9916, and file 08, COORD, v4, identity v3 and corpus v1 all held their pins with the governing tree clean. The scope disclaimers are load-bearing and complete: DR-104 stays DECIDED-V1-NOT-INTEGRATED, no row is SATISFIED or QUALIFIED, D-056 is not opened in either class, no D-096 (A) grant is minted, identity v3 is not rewritten, corpus v1 is not applied, no fixture is executed, file 08 is not edited, and docs/v2/implementation/ is not authorized. The row-ceiling claim is the sharpest thing I checked and it holds precisely: DR-101 through DR-130 is exactly 30 rows, matching Condition 2's denominator, and the DR-201..205 band belongs to Condition 3 — so 'not a register row' is correct and better phrased than the predecessor's. The lane label is precedented at adopted D-123, which recorded v3 under the identical 'leftover-integration T2-02 successor candidate' wording, and v4's own purpose field says the same. The draft is isomorphic to the adopted D-130 form with only correct substitutions. PASS-NO-SCOPE-EFFECT was available but never needed, and is not charged.
